Here, $A$ is a $2\times 4$ matrix and $B$ is a $4\times 2$ matrix. 

There are $4$ columns in $A$ and $4$ rows in $B,$ so $A$ and $B$ are conformable for multiplication:

$$
{A}_{2\times \boxed{\text{4}}}{\cdot }_{✓}{B}_{\boxed{\text{4}}\times 2}={AB}_{2\times 2}
$$

Let's compute the unknown elements of $AB,$ one element at a time:

$$
\begin{aligned} & [\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & -2 & 3 \\ 4 & 1 & 0 & -1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}2 & -1 \\ 1 & 3 \\ 0 & 4 \\ -2 & 1\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-4 & -6 \\ 11 & ∗\end{aligned}], &  & \,-4=1\cdot 2+0\cdot 1+(-2)\cdot 0+3\cdot (-2) \\  & [\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & -2 & 3 \\ 4 & 1 & 0 & -1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}2 & -1 \\ 1 & 3 \\ 0 & 4 \\ -2 & 1\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-4 & -6 \\ 11 & -2\end{aligned}], &  & \,-2=4\cdot (-1)+1\cdot 3+0\cdot 4+(-1)\cdot 1\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
AB=[\begin{aligned}-4 & -6 \\ 11 & -2\end{aligned}].
$$
